news.title: More reliable chat history and calls
news.summary: Windows and Android: histories from the same account's devices are merged without hiding older conversations. Readable cached messages are preserved when cache verification fails. Call setup waits for an authenticated connection, and duplicate offers no longer cause a false busy response. Local enhanced noise suppression is now available to everyone, without MeshPro. Updated Android incoming-call controls and iOS interface fixes are also included in the source release. Update both participants; iOS binaries are distributed separately.

news.title: MeshPro AI tools for your conversations
news.summary: Search selected loaded messages by meaning and jump to the original sources. Save personal writing styles with instructions and examples. Turn selected messages into a plan and review suggested reminders before creating them. Get contextual reply drafts without sending them automatically. Ask questions about PDF text and PNG/JPEG documents with page references (up to 3 MB; first 12 PDF pages). Edit, organize and save personal call notes, or send them to Saved Messages; no automatic call recording. Choose the context before external AI processing. Styles and notes are stored locally for each account.

news.title: Collection bubbles and a smoother interface
news.summary: Choose from 18 illustrated message bubble styles, follow your profile collection or turn artwork off. MeshPro bubble selections are stored on the server and visible to everyone using an updated client. Decorations keep their proportions on short texts, long messages and voice messages. Consistent page transitions and edge-swipe back navigation, with refreshed bottom sheets. Slower background motion, updated replies, chat previews, voice transcripts and attachment menu. Heavy media encoding and cache preparation moved away from the main UI thread.

news.title: Encrypted group calls and shared captions
news.summary: Updated native clients can use the new group audio server with end-to-end encryption and up to 32 invited devices. Each device sends one audio stream, reducing upload requirements in larger calls. MeshPro can start shared captions with participant consent and translation. Joining an ongoing call now restores the connected participant list correctly. Cancelling a connecting call no longer starts a fallback call, and late connection events cannot revive an ended call. Update all participants; browser and older clients retain the existing call route.

news.title: Group audio and shared call captions
news.summary: Group calls now connect up to eight devices with audio between participants and can continue after the initiator leaves. MeshPro can start captions visible to everyone, with individual consent before speech recognition and a choice of translation language. Reconnect handling, pending-message recovery, caption synchronization and photo editing have also been improved. Update all participants before using the new group calls.

news.title: Document scanner inside MeshChat
news.summary: Scan or import several pages, enhance and straighten them, reorder the document and send it to the current chat as an image or PDF. MeshScan and MeshDrop no longer need separate app entries.

news.title: Readable Liquid Glass controls
news.summary: MeshChat now consistently uses its intended dark interface, including on older installations that had a light-theme preference saved. Inactive Liquid Glass buttons and segmented controls remain clearly readable.

news.title: Account recovery and session protection
news.summary: Reset a forgotten password with an email code, review active sessions, sign out other devices and receive an alert when a new device signs in. Recovery codes and suspicious attempts are protected by persistent rate limits.

news.title: Reliable sign-in and registration
news.summary: Login and registration are now separate, email verification survives switching to the mail app or restarting MeshChat, and an unfinished verification can no longer be mistaken for a signed-in account.

news.title: Reliable polls, schedules and call handoff
news.summary: Poll and quiz votes are now protected from duplicates and synchronized across devices, scheduled messages remain server-driven while the app is closed, and active call handoff targets the selected device without disturbing the other devices in the conversation.

news.title: Polls, natural summaries and safer chats
news.summary: Create polls and quizzes in groups and channels, catch up with a natural unread-message recap and jump back to its sources. Voice messages now combine transcription with a short summary, suspicious links and requests are highlighted, and an active personal call can move to another online device.

news.title: Live captions and translation in calls
news.summary: MeshPro can now start AI-powered call captions for everyone in the call, with live translation, fewer repeated phrases and more reliable voice detection. Calls, delivery and multi-device sync were improved too.

news.title: A new home for the Mesh ecosystem
news.summary: Browse apps, read release notes and receive ecosystem news without reinstalling MeshHub.

news.title: MeshChat reliability update
news.summary: Faster sync, improved calls and safer multi-device state recovery.
